dedupe_keys.name: dyno demand travel demand data standard for dynamic network models

description: Dyno-Demand is a travel demand data standard for dynamic network modelling, written to pair with network standards such as GTFS-Plus. The specification repository gives version 0.1.2, created on 17 June 2015 and updated on 15 August 2016, with authors from the San Francisco County Transportation Authority, LMZ LLC and UrbanLabs LLC. Its core file is a trip list with trip attributes, a mandatory person trip id and an optional tour id, first documented in technical memos of the Fast-Trips project. Coverage: any study area. Format and access: a public specification. Licence and cost: Apache 2.0, free. Caveats: an early version not updated since 2016. It supports network flow and agent-based models that need trip-level demand. It relates to GTFS-Plus and the General Modeling Network Specification (GMNS) in the catalogue.
